profile_text.body:
Character.AI is a company founded in 2022 that operates character.ai, a chat service built around conversational AI characters. The site describes the product as AI chat reimagined, with the taglines "Your Words. Your World." and an invitation to chat with millions of AI Characters on what it calls the number one AI chat app. Its product listing is a persona chat offering, and that listing carries a noted HR or appropriate-use risk.

The company's own material is almost entirely promotional, centered on the scale of its character library and the open-ended nature of the conversations rather than on technical or business detail. No litigation, regulatory filings, patent records, or other outside facts are part of the available record.
